name: Nate Parnell
headline: Manchester personal trainer for fat loss, muscle building and mobility
bio: Nate is a Manchester-based personal trainer with over five years' experience, coaching 1-to-1 at a studio in the city and online through an app. Sessions cover weight management, resistance training, muscle building, mobility and speed and power work, with nutrition advice alongside. LGBTQ+ friendly and fully insured.

name: Lift
headline: Inclusive, LGBTQ+ friendly and neurodivergent-affirming PT in Manchester
bio: Lift offers 1-to-1 and small group personal training in Manchester, plus nutrition coaching and physiotherapy. Founder and head coach Ray built it as a pressure-free alternative to intimidating gyms, with a focus on strength, confidence and mental wellbeing. In person or online.

name: Kerry O'Connor
headline: 1-to-1 personal training in a private Manchester city centre gym
bio: Kerry has been a personal trainer in Manchester since 2011 and now trains clients 1-to-1 in a private gym in the city centre, as well as coaching online. Specialises in weight management and athletic performance, mixing weights, circuits, cardio and bodyweight work, with nutrition plans available.

name: Gym 72
headline: Private 1-to-1 PT studios in Manchester city centre since 2013
bio: Gym 72 is a personal-training-only gym with two private studios in Manchester city centre, one on Sackville Street and one on Jackson's Row. A team of male and female trainers, each with at least two years' experience, coach 1-to-1 with nutrition support and an app for tracking progress.

name: The Portuguese Coach
headline: Fat loss and muscle gain coaching in Manchester's Northern Quarter
bio: João offers 1-to-1 personal training in the Northern Quarter and online coaching across the UK. Eight years in, the focus is fat loss, muscle gain and full body transformations built on training and eating habits you can keep long term.

name: Sarah Spearing
headline: Women's health, strength and body-positive PT in Chorlton
bio: Sarah runs bespoke 1-to-1 sessions from her private studio in Chorlton, or over Zoom. Her interests are holistic health, confidence and body positivity, and fitness for women, including menopause and post-natal recovery. Sessions draw on strength work, kettlebells, HIIT, pilates, yoga and running.

name: Mickie Love
headline: Strength, muscle and fat loss coaching from a private Salford studio
bio: Mickie is a personal trainer covering Salford and Manchester, training clients 1-to-1 at a private studio at The Performance Space in Salford. The coaching focuses on getting strong, building muscle, losing body fat and building confidence through habits that last.

name: M20 Personal Training
headline: Private PT studio on Kingsway in Didsbury
bio: M20 Personal Training is a team of male and female trainers running 1-to-1 sessions from a private studio on Kingsway in Didsbury. They cover weight loss and toning, strength and conditioning, and pre and post-natal training, and have helped clients prepare for events such as their first half marathon.
qualifications: Registered with the Register of Exercise Professionals

name: Nurtured PT
headline: Strength training for women at every stage, from Didsbury
bio: Jess is a Didsbury-based personal trainer specialising in women's strength, from complete beginners to pregnancy, perimenopause and beyond. She currently coaches through online programmes, including a home strength programme and a pre-natal guide, with a waitlist open for in-person PT spots.

name: Adele
headline: Welcoming, inclusive PT in Salford for gym newcomers
bio: Adele is a personal trainer in Salford offering 1-to-1 and small group training, plus online coaching. Her approach is inclusive and non-judgemental, aimed especially at people who feel uneasy in the gym, and covers strength, fitness, weight loss and healthy habits.

name: The Olympus Projects
headline: Small group PT for strength and conditioning in Manchester
bio: The Olympus Projects runs small group personal training in groups of up to six, alongside 1-to-1 guidance and structured programmes. The emphasis is on strength, conditioning, discipline and accountability rather than quick fixes.

name: Personal Train Your Fitness
headline: Friendly, personalised PT at The Northern in West Didsbury
bio: Personal Train Your Fitness coaches from The Northern in West Didsbury, a relaxed and light gym. Sessions are tailored to your current fitness level and suit people new to exercise or returning after a break. Paired sessions for two are available at a lower price each.

name: Henry Roy
headline: Strongman-style strength coaching from a private studio in Redfield
bio: Henry runs a private 1-to-1 and small group studio in Redfield, east Bristol, with two gym rooms and an outdoor area. Expect specialist kit like logs, axle bars and tyres alongside the basics, and a coach who adapts exercises around sore joints. He won North Somerset's Strongest Man in 2024.

name: Carly
headline: Joyful, inclusive 1-to-1 PT in a private studio in Hanham
bio: Carly is an inclusive personal trainer with a private studio in Hanham, BS15. Her coaching skips weigh-ins, calorie counting and before-and-after photos and focuses on strength, confidence and enjoying movement. Choose in-person sessions, an app-based plan or a mix of both.

name: OPEX Bristol
headline: Coach-led personal programmes in a private gym at Ashton Gate
bio: OPEX Bristol starts with a face-to-face consultation and fitness assessment, then builds you an individual programme to follow in their private Ashton Gate gym with coaches on the floor. Nutrition and lifestyle support are included, and programmes are reviewed as you progress.

name: Kimmy
headline: Body-positive strength training and rehab in St George
bio: Kimmy runs a holistic health and fitness business from a studio in St George, Bristol. She offers general strength training, exercise for mental health, pre and post-natal sessions (children welcome), menopause support and injury rehab, 1-to-1 or with up to two friends. LGBTQ+ owned, with no gym membership needed.

name: Em-Fit Personal Training
headline: Women-only personal training in Clifton Village, plus home visits
bio: Emma offers women-only 1-to-1 personal training at a private studio in Clifton Village, with home visits around Clifton and online sessions too. Every session is planned around your goals, with nutrition support between sessions. Pre and post-natal training is also available.

name: Fitness with Mel
headline: Women's health and menopause fitness from a private Bristol studio
bio: Mel is a Level 4 personal trainer and women's health coach with her own private studio in Bristol. She specialises in perimenopause and postmenopause, and is also qualified in GP exercise referral, suspension training and kettlebells. A CIMSPA member and fully insured.

name: MyLife PT
headline: Personal training, physio and sports massage near the harbourside
bio: MyLife PT is a team offering 1-to-1 personal training in a private gym space at Brunel Lock, alongside physiotherapy, sport-specific training, sports massage and online plans. No gym membership or long commitment needed.

name: Stuart
headline: Weight loss and toning coaching in Clifton with 15 years' experience
bio: Stuart is a Clifton-based personal trainer with 15 years' experience, helping clients with weight loss, toning and general fitness. Training comes with tailored nutrition and lifestyle advice, and he works with people from all backgrounds.

name: RL Body Trainer
headline: Personal training, boxing and Muay Thai around Clifton and Redland
bio: An established 1-to-1 personal trainer with over 30 years in the job, working around Clifton, Redland, Flax Bourton and Nailsea. Offers gym, studio, park and home sessions, small group training, circuits and bootcamps, boxing and Muay Thai pads, sport-specific programming and nutrition advice.

name: LUP Bristol
headline: Strength for everyday life for over-35s in Southville
bio: LUP Bristol is a lifestyle and personal training gym in the centre of Southville, aimed at people over 35 who want to feel stronger, move more easily and ease aches and pains. Sessions are tailored to your goals and any injuries, with coach check-ins and online programmes.

name: Trymwood Fitness
headline: Personal training, small group classes and sports massage in BS9
bio: Trymwood Fitness offers personal training, small group HIIT, resistance and stretching classes, and sports massage in north west Bristol.
